description: This file defines types, interfaces, and functions for handling CBOR tags, including tagged data items, raw tags, tag options, and a thread-safe tag set. It includes methods for marshalling, unmarshalling, and managing CBOR tags, as well as error handling for tag mismatches.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Represents a tagged data item with a tag number and content.

classes.name: RawTag
classes.description: Represents a raw tagged data item with a tag number and raw message content.

classes.name: TagOptions
classes.description: Specifies how encoder and decoder handle tag numbers.

classes.name: tagItem
classes.description: Internal structure for storing tag information, including tag numbers, content type, and options.

classes.name: tagSet
classes.description: Type alias for a map of reflect.Type to tagItem, representing a set of tags.

classes.name: syncTagSet
classes.description: Thread-safe implementation of TagSet with synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: WrongTagError
classes.description: Error type for mismatched CBOR tag and registered tag.

methods.name: UnmarshalCBOR
methods.description: Sets *RawTag with data, decoding CBOR tag number and content.

methods.name: DecTagMode.valid
methods.description: Checks if DecTagMode value is valid.

methods.name: EncTagMode.valid
methods.description: Checks if EncTagMode value is valid.

methods.name: TagSet.Add
methods.description: Adds a tag number, content type, and options to the TagSet.

methods.name: TagSet.Remove
methods.description: Removes a content type from the TagSet.

methods.name: newTagItem
methods.description: Creates a new tagItem with validation.
